additional_info.subject: AW: ID0399293-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R6 170002100] Charger issue CRM:00798001674
additional_info.body:
Hello,
I am happy to describe the error once again:
Could you pls summarize the issue.
Charger offline, HMi off, side LEDs off, PLC off, Fuse FC13-FC17 off, Fuse FC12 on
When was the last site intervention happened? is it before/on 18th or after 18th?
The problem last occurred on 18 December 2024
If the issue, repeative in nature? if so, How frequent.
Yes, this is a recurring problem. The error has always occurred sporadically.
Sometimes the error does not occur for four weeks and then again several times a week.
If you know, Other than reboot, what are activity performed to resolve the issue?
We only switch off the fuse FC12 and switch it on again after a few seconds. The system then restarts.
I hope that the problem can now be solved quickly.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen / Best Regards
Hendrik Herkes

additional_info.subject: RE: AW: ID0399293-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R6 170002100] Charger issue CRM:00798001674
additional_info.body:
Hello Hendrik,
Thanks for providing the additional information.
We have noticed that the charger is running an older firmware version (v4.0.11). We recommend updating it to the latest firmware version (v6.0.3) to ensure smooth operation.
Please confirm if we can proceed with the remote firmware update?
After that, we can do the performance analysis of the charger. If the same issue still persist, then will investigate further.
Meanwhile we will also analyze the issue that happened back on 18th Dec 2024 and get back to you.
Thank you
Best Regards
eMobility Tech Support Team - Vaishnavi Raut
